meta.title: SmartSchool – free school management for every school
meta.description: SmartSchool is free, open-source school management software. It runs offline in rural schools and online for schools that want full automation.
nav.label: Main menu
lang.label: Language
hero.title: Our schools deserve the money, not unused software.
hero.subtitle: Public money is spent on school systems that are mostly left unused, while many schools still lack electricity and equipment. SmartSchool does the same job for free, on the computers schools already have.
problem.title: Where is the money going?
problem.intro: Schools are given expensive systems with many features that never get used. In rural schools, some students still don't have electricity or basic equipment. That money comes from taxpayers, and it could have gone to classrooms.
problem.c2: Share of features that go unused
problem.c3: Public schools still without electricity, mostly in remote areas
problem.c4: What that money could buy instead: proper classrooms, chairs and desks, classroom supplies, clean restrooms (CRs), and safe open spaces for students.
problem.todo_hint: Placeholder – add a verified figure and its source.
problem.closing: We are not against technology in schools. We are against paying for features nobody uses. SmartSchool is free so the budget can go where it's needed most.

who.title: Who SmartSchool is for
who.c1.title: Rural and low-resource schools
who.c1.text: Runs on one ordinary computer. Phones and laptops connect through the school Wi-Fi, even with no internet at all.
who.c2.title: Schools that want full automation
who.c2.text: Put it online so families can register students, and parents can see grades and attendance from home.
who.c3.title: Teachers
who.c3.text: Attendance, grades, report cards and forms are done for you, so you have more time to actually teach.
features.title: What SmartSchool can do
features.intro: Everything a school needs day to day, in one place.
features.f1.title: Online registration
features.f1.text: Families fill in the form and upload documents online. The registrar approves with one click.
features.f2.title: QR attendance
features.f2.text: Students scan their ID at the gate and in class. Parents are told if their child is late or absent.
features.f3.title: Grades and report cards
features.f3.text: Teachers type in scores. Grades are computed for you and report cards print in one click.
features.f4.title: Less paperwork for teachers
features.f4.text: Class lists, schedules, reminders and reports are made automatically.
features.f5.title: Works offline
features.f5.text: No internet? No problem. Everyone on the same Wi-Fi can still use it.
features.f6.title: English and Tagalog
features.f6.text: Made for Filipino schools, in the languages people actually use.
features.f7.title: Open source
features.f7.text: The code is public. Anyone can check it, improve it, or adapt it for their school.
photos.title: Our schools
photos.intro: The schools SmartSchool is made for.
install.title: How to install
install.intro: Five simple steps. You choose Offline (LAN) or Online inside the installer – not before downloading.

install.help_text: SmartSchool is free for everyone. If you have thousands of students or need enterprise-level hosting (fast servers, backups, setup and support), contact the developer for paid professional help.
download.title: Download SmartSchool
download.checksum_title: How do I know the file is safe? (checksum)
download.checksum_text: A checksum is like a fingerprint of the file. If your file's fingerprint matches the one shown here, the file is complete and has not been changed by anyone.
download.checksum_match: Compare the long code that appears with the SHA-256 code shown under your download button. They must be exactly the same.
faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: Yes. There are no license fees and no paid version. If you put it online, you only pay your own hosting company, and you can choose any company you like.
faq.a2: No. In offline mode, one computer runs SmartSchool and other devices connect through the school Wi-Fi. You only need internet if you want parents and students to use it from home.
faq.a3: Your data stays on your own computer or your own server, not with us. Each person only sees what their role allows, and every change is recorded. Your school is still responsible for following the Data Privacy Act (RA 10173).
faq.a4: SmartSchool is an independent community project. Anyone can report problems, suggest improvements or help fix them on GitHub.
faq.a5: Yes. It's open source, so you can adapt it to your school's needs, or ask a developer to help you.
oss.title: Open source: built together
oss.intro: SmartSchool belongs to everyone who uses it. There's no company that can lock you in or raise the price.
oss.license_text: Free to use, share and change under this license:
oss.teachers_text: Tell us what's hard to use, suggest features, check the Tagalog wording, or share the project with other schools.
oss.devs_text: Fix bugs, add features, improve speed on older computers, or help translate. Start with the issues on GitHub.
footer.disclaimer: SmartSchool is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to DepEd or any government agency.

faq.q6: What if I forget the Superadmin password?
faq.a6: The Superadmin is the most important account – write its email and password down and keep them somewhere safe. Every other account can be reset by the Superadmin, but nobody can recover the Superadmin for you.
